record.context_brief: adiabatic Weyl formula for arbitrary foliations
record.original_question: Let F be an arbitrary foliation on a compact Riemannian manifold, with codimension q, tangential Laplacian Delta_F, transverse Laplacian Delta_H, linearized foliation F_N on the conormal bundle N^*F, induced metric function g_N on N^*F, and noncommutative trace tr_{F_N}. Does the adiabatic asymptotic formula tr f(Delta_F + h^2 Delta_H) = (2 pi)^{-q} h^{-q} tr_{F_N} f(Delta_{F_N} + g_N) + o(h^{-q}) hold as h -> 0 for every compactly supported smooth function f?

evidence.quote: Observe that the formula (10) makes sense for an arbitrary, not necessarily Riemannian, foliation. Therefore, it is quite reasonable to conjecture that it holds in such generality.

Conjecture 3.15. Let F be an arbitrary foliation on a compact Riemannian manifold. In the above notation, for any function f in C_c^infinity(R), the asymptotic formula holds: tr f(Delta_F + h^2 Delta_H) = (2pi)^{-q} h^{-q} tr_{F_N} f(Delta_{F_N} + g_N) + o(h^{-q}), h -> 0.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a smooth compact Riemannian manifold and let $\mathcal{F}$ be a (not necessarily Riemannian) smooth foliation on $M$ of codimension $q$. Let $T\mathcal{F}\subset TM$ denote the tangent bundle to the leaves and let $H\subset TM$ be a smooth subbundle complementary to $T\mathcal{F}$, so that $TM=T\mathcal{F}\oplus H$. The Riemannian metric on $M$ induces a leafwise (tangential) Laplacian $\Delta_{\mathcal{F}}$ acting along leaves and, via the splitting, a transverse Laplacian $\Delta_H$.

Let $N^*\mathcal{F}\subset T^*M$ denote the conormal bundle to $\mathcal{F}$. The foliation $\mathcal{F}$ lifts to the linearized foliation $\mathcal{F}_N$ on $N^*\mathcal{F}$, whose leaves are given by the differential of the holonomy along the conormal directions. Let $\Delta_{\mathcal{F}_N}$ be the tangential Laplacian for $\mathcal{F}_N$ with respect to the natural metric induced on $N^*\mathcal{F}$, and let $g_N\colon N^*\mathcal{F}\to\mathbb{R}$ denote the induced fiberwise quadratic function (the squared norm in the transverse metric). Let $\operatorname{tr}_{\mathcal{F}_N}$ denote the noncommutative trace associated with the holonomy groupoid of $\mathcal{F}_N$ on $N^*\mathcal{F}$, applied to leafwise smoothing operators of trace-class type.

For a parameter $h>0$, consider the adiabatic-type operator $\Delta_{\mathcal{F}}+h^2\Delta_H$ acting on $L^2(M)$.

Question: Is it true that for every $f\in C_c^{\infty}(\mathbb{R})$ one has the asymptotic formula
$$\operatorname{tr} f(\Delta_{\mathcal{F}}+h^2\Delta_H)=(2\pi)^{-q}h^{-q}\,\operatorname{tr}_{\mathcal{F}_N} f(\Delta_{\mathcal{F}_N}+g_N)+o(h^{-q})$$
as $h\to 0^+$?
artifact.status_search_result: The asymptotic formula has been proved for Riemannian foliations with bundle-like metrics by Kordyukov and Yakovlev, but no source confirms a proof for general (non-Riemannian) foliations; the conjecture appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Adiabatic Limits and the Spectrum of the Laplacian on Foliated Manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Results on adiabatic-limit eigenvalue distribution are obtained for Riemannian foliated manifolds with bundle-like metrics.
status_evidence.claim: The proven results are in the Riemannian foliation setting, leaving the general (non-Riemannian) case unaddressed.

status_evidence.title: Adiabatic limits and spectral geometry of foliations
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses semiclassical Weyl asymptotics for tangential plus rescaled transverse Laplacians on Riemannian foliations.
status_evidence.claim: Available proofs are confined to the Riemannian foliation case.

status_evidence.title: Noncommutative Geometry, Spectral Asymptotics, and Semiclassical Analysis
status_evidence.snippet: Recent survey of semiclassical Weyl laws in noncommutative settings; does not record a proof of the conjectured adiabatic Weyl formula for arbitrary foliations.
status_evidence.claim: No proof of the general foliation conjecture is reported in recent surveys.
